Article


Flexport Forward came to Amsterdam on 5 November 2026, and guests gathered at the Rijksmuseum, finishing the day with a guided tour of the museum. Flexport's chief executive officer (CEO) Ryan Petersen set out how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing logistics, Chris Rogers of S&P Global walked through the bottlenecks that broke 2026, and three customers explained what 2027 means for their supply chains.
